author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Adafruit has previewed Floppsy Rev D, an RP2350-based floppy disk archiver and emulator designed to preserve and access legacy computer storage media. The standalone device supports floppy drives used with PCs and Apple Disk II systems, offering disk imaging, flux-level data capture, and emulation capabilities alongside a touchscreen interface and removable storage. title: Adafruit Floppsy Rev D Revives Floppy Disk Archiving with RP2350

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: LILYGO’s latest e-paper development board pairs an ESP32-S3 with a 4.7-inch display offering 960 × 540 resolution and 16-level grayscale. The board also includes battery monitoring, removable storage, and Wi-Fi and BLE connectivity for portable information displays and wireless embedded projects. title: LILYGO T5 e-Paper Basic Adopts 4.7-Inch Display for Embedded Projects
